Andy Ogles addresses jobs growth, national priorities, and parental rights in recent posts
Rep. Andy Ogles posted on X on October 7-8 about Republican-led job growth initiatives, prioritizing American interests over globalism with thanks to Senator Rubio, and criticized Massachusetts officials regarding parental rights and gender...
Rep. Andy Ogles, U.S. Congressman representing Tennessee's 5th district, has recently made several statements on his official X (formerly Twitter) account regarding economic growth, national priorities, and family rights.
On October 7, 2026, Ogles stated: "Republicans are creating record level jobs and securing historic investments Democrats drove OUT of America. President Trump is growing our nation’s superpower status."
Later that day, he posted another message emphasizing national sovereignty: "We are rebuilding America’s national power. We will not put globalism over Americanism. Renewing our heritage and our institutions is top of mind! Thank you, @SecRubio!" The post thanked Senator Marco Rubio for his contributions to these efforts.
On October 8, 2026, Ogles addressed issues surrounding parental rights and gender ideology in Massachusetts: "Nobody has the right to rip a child away from her parents because they refuse to bow to perverse gender ideology. Radical Massachusetts bureaucrats have no problem destroying a family, maligning their faith, and accusing good parents just to desecrate the incontrovertible."
These posts reflect ongoing debates within U.S. politics about job creation, foreign policy priorities, and the role of government in family matters. Congressional discussions continue regarding economic policies and cultural issues such as parental rights and education.
